title: Customer messages beyond orders in one list
problem: Only order events could send SMS or email; refunds, invoices, tickets, warranty and account messages had no settings.
now: Notifications lists every event by group with SMS, WhatsApp, email, customer and shop switches and editable text; tickets, invoice reminders and service requests send.
steps: Open Settings › Notifications and scroll to Customers and account
Turn on Ticket opened and edit its text
Make a new support ticket with a phone number and see the message in the delivery log
On a customer's Invoices, open an unpaid invoice and send a reminder
left: Invoice sent and Sign-in code show Not sent yet: nothing sends an invoice on its own and sign-in codes need the server; loyalty messages stay in Loyalty.
